data.content_ref: inline:The compatibility claim fails because SRC_004's sequential guard-installation account requires temporal ordering of installation operations to explain the 3-of-26 distribution, while SRC_005's registry-semantics mechanism (entries constrained only under a detectable guard) is atemporal and state-based. If the test merely constrains entries installed under a detectable guard regardless of when that guard was installed (SRC_005), this contradicts the sequential dependency essential to SRC_004's explanation. The proposed refutation conditions test whether the installation-order artifact generalizes, but do not test whether the two mechanisms can simultaneously explain the same data: if the sequential order is causally necessary (SRC_004), then a static registry state (SRC_005) cannot capture the mechanism, and conversely, if the registry state is sufficient, the sequential narrative is explanatorily superfluous. Thus the mechanisms contradict rather than merely differ in description.
